harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as router between two VLANs: eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) toward node2, eth2 (192.168.20.1/24) toward node3, with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. node2 (192.168.10.2/24 on enp8s0) and node3 (192.168.20.2/24 on enp8s0) each got a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified full bidirectional ping between node2 and node3 across the VLAN boundary (ttl=63 confirming one hop). Config was persisted (SONiC via /etc/network/interfaces.d + sysctl.d; RHEL9 via nmcli connection profiles) and all three nodes were sequentially restarted (one at a time) using native reboot, each showing a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and full recovery of interfaces, forwarding sysctls, static routes, and end-to-end cross-VLAN connectivity afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected interfaces/routes on node1/node2/node3 to map topology (node1 eth1<->node2 enp8s0, node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0)
Cleaned SONiC docker0/reconciler interference on node1 per sonic-reference
Assigned 192.168.10.1/24 to node1 eth1 and 192.168.20.1/24 to node1 eth2, enabled global+per-iface IPv4 forwarding
Assigned 192.168.10.2/24 to node2 enp8s0 and 192.168.20.2/24 to node3 enp8s0
Verified node1 could ping both hosts directly
Added static cross-VLAN routes on node2 and node3 via node1
Verified node2<->node3 ping success (ttl=63, one hop via node1)
Persisted node1 config via /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan-routing.conf and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Persisted node2/node3 config via nmcli connection modify (ipv4.addresses, ipv4.routes) on 'Wired connection 2'
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed, verified eth1/eth2 IPs, forwarding sysctls, and direct+cross-VLAN ping recovered
Restarted node2 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 IP, route, and ping to node3 recovered
Restarted node3 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 IP, route, and ping to node2 recovered
Ran final bidirectional ping check between node2 and node3 post all-restarts

evidence.summary: node1 eth1 assigned 192.168.10.1/24 and eth2 assigned 192.168.20.1/24, both up, with forwarding sysctls enabled

node1 interfaces/sysctl persisted to /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d; node2/node3 persisted via nmcli connection profiles with routes, confirmed active

evidence.summary: node1 baseline boot_id 34192023-...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 113009b4-...; eth1/eth2 IPs, forwarding sysctls, and direct+cross-VLAN pings all confirmed recovered

evidence.summary: node2 baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c-...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 4288e09b-...; enp8s0 IP, static route, and ping to node3 confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart evidence: baseline boot_id, restart, changed boot_id, recovered state
evidence.summary: node3 baseline boot_id 98aa35f5-...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 9d4f5cd4-...; enp8s0 IP, static route, and ping to node2 confirmed recovered

evidence.summary: Final bidirectional ping test between node2 (192.168.10.2) and node3 (192.168.20.2) succeeded with 0% loss after all nodes had been individually restarted
